text: nānumiyyati na tena saṅkhaṃ gacchati . vedanañce nānuseti . saññañce nānuseti . saṅkhāre ce nānuseti . viññāṇañce nānuseti na taṃ anumiyyati yaṃ nānumiyyati na tena saṅkhaṃ gacchati . imassa khvāhaṃ bhante bhagavatā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāmīti . [78] sādhu sādhu bhikkhu sādhu kho tvaṃ bhikkhu mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāsi . rūpañce bhikkhu anuseti taṃ
